# GMEOW GTS Transport Module

The GMEOW GTS Transport Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/gts>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/gts`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Transport/packaging vocabulary so GMEOW can DESCRIBE and dogfood its own
transport: a GTS file (docs/GTS-SPEC.md) as a first-class entity — its segments, profiles,
chain heads, transform codecs, opaque (sealed/undecodable) frames, and compaction lineage.

MODEL BOUNDARIES (Principles 1, 9, 12).
- GTS gives TRANSPORT claims (these bytes, this order, this chain); GMEOW gives CONTENT
  claims (this statement is true, according to whom). A frame signature or head commitment
  is an Attestation whose attestedSubject is a GTSSegment; it proves bytes/order/signer key
  control, never the truth of the carried statements (#342).
- Compaction re-authors only the ORDERING: content claims ride as ordinary quads and are
  rewrite-invariant by construction; transport claims over the old chain become detached
  evidence about the source document, cited through the compaction's derivation lineage.
- Fold semantics, codec reversal, hash verification, and signature checking live in the
  solver layer (the gts engines); this module only describes their artifacts and outcomes.

REUSE (no parallel mechanisms — #267).
- Byte identity of blobs and files     -> gmeow:contentDigest (sources).
- Chain-head identity of a segment     -> gmeow:gtsHeadId, a versionFingerprint (versions).
- Frame/head signatures, signers       -> gmeow:hasSignature / gmeow:Attestation (attestation).
- Compaction and production lineage    -> gmeow:wasGeneratedBy / wasDerivedFrom (provenance).
- Suppress frames                      -> gmeow:displayable (kernel, P10) — suppression is a
  display overlay, never erasure, in the format AND in the ontology.
- annot-frame standpoints              -> gmeow:accordingTo / standpointModality (standpoint).
- Media payloads                       -> gmeow:MediaObject (documents) carried as blobs.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/gts>
